bb.name: Design director
bb.description: Catch a screen that looks generic before you call the work done, and keep every design score on record. A critic scores each screenshot without seeing the code, so the agent that built the screen is not the one grading it. Three tiers run from a 0.03 USD spot check after any UI change to a 3-to-5 USD redesign with seeded directions. Critic runs spend provider tokens, and the screenshot scripts need Chrome or Chromium and Node 18 or newer.
